title: US fitted a non-human power source into a human-built craft ('Ferrari engine in a Pinto')

tellings.quote: there is evidence that we, meaning the the United States, have been able to put a non- human power source into a constructed body of other craft.

plain: The United States is said to have managed to put a power source of non-human origin into a craft built by humans, something like fitting a Ferrari engine into a Pinto, a cheap small car. The filmmaker and journalist Jeremy Corbell says there is evidence of this, citing sources he names, which would mean the US has made partial use of technology it did not invent.
